title: Posting every day won't fix a brand problem.

slides.label: Brand & content
slides.title: Posting every day won't fix a brand problem.

slides.label: 01 · Strategy
slides.title: Decide who it's for.
slides.body: One audience, one thing you want them to do. Every post should push toward it.

slides.label: 02 · Brand
slides.title: Pick one look and keep it.
slides.body: Same colors, same type, same voice. People should know it's you before they read your name.

slides.label: 03 · Photo
slides.title: Real beats stock.
slides.body: Your team, your work, your space. Stock photos tell people you have nothing to show.

slides.label: 04 · Film
slides.title: Show the process, not just the finish.
slides.body: The before, the build, the hands at work. That's where trust comes from.

slides.label: 05 · Social media
slides.title: Plan the month, not the morning.
slides.body: A simple calendar beats scrambling for something to post at 9 p.m.

slides.label: 06 · Collaborations
slides.title: Borrow an audience.
slides.body: Partner with a business your customers already trust. One good collab can outwork a month of posts.

caption:
Posting every day won't fix a brand problem.

What actually moves people:
1. A strategy: one audience, one action
2. One look, kept everywhere
3. Real photos over stock
4. Video of the process, not just the finish
5. A monthly content plan
6. Collaborations with brands your customers already trust
